description: This file defines an abstract base class 'ExtensionStreamBase' for stream wrappers related to extension assets in Drupal. It includes methods for handling URIs, extracting extension names, generating URLs, and checking file extensions.

classes.name: ExtensionStreamBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing base functionality for stream wrappers handling extension assets in Drupal.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of stream wrapper, combining LOCAL and READ flags.

methods.name: setUri
methods.description: Sets the URI after validating its format and checking file extension.

methods.name: getExtensionName
methods.description: Extracts and returns the extension name from the URI.

methods.name: getExtension
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the extension object given its name.

methods.name: getTarget
methods.description: Retrieves the target path from the parent stream and checks file extension.

methods.name: getExternalUrl
methods.description: Generates the external URL for the extension asset.

methods.name: dirname
methods.description: Returns the directory name of the URI, ensuring the extension exists.

methods.name: getDirectoryPath
methods.description: Returns the filesystem path of the extension.

methods.name: checkFileExtension
methods.description: Validates the file extension against allowed extensions for the scheme.
